demoDatasetNotice: This dashboard currently ships with a representative demonstration dataset modeled on public aggregate reporting patterns (WHO / Our World in Data style). It is built so the demo files in /data can be swapped for a complete historical dataset without changing any application code.
disclaimer: This dashboard is an educational and portfolio demonstration using aggregated historical COVID-19 data. Reported figures may differ between countries because of differences in testing, reporting practices, definitions, revisions, and data availability. This dashboard is not a medical, epidemiological, or public-health decision-making system.
